entry.title: Team communications - informal mails
entry.content:
Inbox Ashish Tanwar : aktanwar@google.com Fri, Jan 7, 2022, 4:21 PM to India, me

Hi Team,

This may be my last allowed communication here, doing this because I really doubt the reality or rather applicability of those values and culture (LT, its called SRE, something we preach) in our team.

Now : I alleged harassment, discrimination, bias and all bad things after i was rated NI by enligtened and respected Rajesh Ramdas with firm endorsement from L/T . I appealed and lost.

I will leave the judgment to you...needy, delusional, whatever.....i am gone anyways.

Now I have you hooked, so I will make it absolutely worth your time.

First 3 months:

My CV is on my MOMA profile, it won't take a genius to notice that I should be in the D/N or AppMod team. I was ACE and PCA certified even before google interviewed me. Thats something which Mitesh and Rajesh, Rachit, Kapil have "conveniently" chose to ignore and plead the third amendment - "Management reserves the right to allocate based on priority of business..blah blah".

Anyways, I don't have either the equipment or work allocated to me, I used this time to learn about the culture ( proof - see my moma batch, and my annoying memegens). One thing became evident - we survive by logic and foresightedness.

Enter Rachit Mitesh and Arun Sajwan.

I am allocated BFSI - no rhyme or reason. I am starving for work, put under immense pressure by Rachit and Arun Sajwan, combined with Mitesh and Kapil. eg - cold calling, pursuing leads via partners, being humiliated for not being good at it. These "leaders" force me to use stolen artifacts from oracle to create their elusive "account plan". I resist, and get crucified for it. Arun is OOO to never return. I am constantly humiliated by Rachit who is openly targeting me now. Focused on learning about BSI, I created a solution based on my 3 months ``expertise" on BFSI, on boarding customers and seeking new opportunities.

Start of 2021 :

I ask Rachit to allocate me D/N. I wasn't given. I was given CPG and an opportunity to help every FSR who needed help. Rachit was shortly out of action, so I took this as a challenge to max out and put my skills to test. Here is the somewhat comprehensive list of accounts on which I have worked, Remember, even auto, iot accounts were denied to me. All i got was "maruti" as the "Biggest Opportunity"

Unacknowledged Impact in BFSI:

I even got a deal closed - Voice translation API for PNB bank. I even went to interview potential partners to realize the deal - wipro, infosys, tech m - finally selected and on-boarded by me - Saurabh D can attest.

I never got even a mention in the pipe I predominantly created and realized when Arun Sajwan was out of action. Ask Pranshu - If i did not go over and beyond to onboard him. All I ever got was 2 shadow sessions and a reminder in every team meeting that I am not good enough. I choose to focus on the skills I lacked - patience, communication and anxiety in big meetings.

Remember, this is the time when the team was falling sick, left and right. I am helping Vipul, Nimisha, Nitin, Diya, Kamal, Rohit and doing capacity planning with Himanshu, also trying to fill in for anyone that is feeling unwell. Except for 2 contentious meetings of probably 200+ senior personnel I communicated with, these meetings went well - something that I believe none of my FSRs can deny.

Contentious Meet 1 - Mr CIO (not sure) Manish Garg/Patanjali.

Rude person. Immensely lacks manners, logic or value. I was insulted initially by title, then by experience, by skill, by values and finally by "Indianness". That was the last straw.

Trivia/Shameless self boasting : Not many people can claim to have proven a crucial contribution to development of our country's newly launched nuclear powered sub. Yes I am now proud that my code runs there....and it is still being used, reused and appreciated. I can get you un-official testaments from a currently serving Col. and Cdr and their lead engineer.

Snide comment : I know embedded, micro-controller, electronics, mobile apps, now cloud. When I say know - I have and can build them from scratch - from a chip supplier to programming or creating the toolchain, apps and finally selling it to end customers.

My end customers have been Cairn energy, then Home Minister, Trai Chief engineer, Heads of Police, BSF etc, Kiran Bedi mam, heads of state security to mobile manufactures like karbon, micromax etc.

I influenced the requirements by TRAI on mobile operators that now have made it mandatory for them to provide at least 30 mtr of geolocation accuracy for tracking. Influenced and made them aware that telecom providers are not providing "real time" tracking as they are hiding the X interface - GSM ref.

Anyways - i ended up telling the customer - "Sir, I will send you the link to the entire portfolio, Please do call me if you need us. I have more intelligent customers who actually need me". I know....this was after an hours of humiliation being labeled a data chor (Google and I were betraying the country for working there).

10 seconds of silence. He could not believe a "sales" ka sirf customer engineer can tell the factual truth to an "innocent" person. Then he starts selling patanjali to us - giving us requirements and all. I am really running late to an yum IOT opportunity - renew meters. I wanted to calm my nerves before that, so this time i am genuinely asking Dear Customer to let me go, he ends up giving us requirements for his immediate "VM/Physical server requirement" - GCPs value proposition. FSR and I sync up after call, HI5 and conclude that this was an amazing meeting.

All pumped up, we have a great opening meeting at Renew again. Good, hard week....this is Friday....finally a weekend when I can be proud of the week I had. 10 PM, unusual chat ping from FSR. She inquires whether we can talk.

Trivia : I am a father of one 5 year old human, 2 very loving yet annoying dogs and a pseudo father of 40 - 60 street dogs.

After 6 PM, my highly stressed wife had given me a notice - money is not enough, you are needed. There was proof to that - my son was not speaking Hindi even at 4 years. Corona time....we all struggle with this. I am barely giving time to anyone.

My mom passes - i am in Noida, she lives in our old permanent home at rohini, Delhi. I am guilty of not making enough time for her, and probably causing her death....i am still coping up with this guilt.

The reason I am telling you this is to simply imply that 7PM to 11Pm is an absolute must for me - I have to take over from my wife who is highly stressed being in the final leg of her Phd. She is doing well.

Anyways, Mr Patanjali Customer, probably after getting drunk at 10PM on Friday, gave a call to former FSR and apparently threatened to file a police complaint.

I was all for it - It was on web conf, and I thought the version is exaggerated, I tell the FSR to sleep it off, after i finally get done with my day which ends at 11 PM normally - this includes making food for my street dogs - being hated for it, and recently being attacked for it. I hope you saw the video. This is after my moms's demise on 28 April, coincidentally the week when Rachit joins back from vacation. He is trying to do his thing again - perpetrating general hate against me - my lack of patience, skills and after this meeting 1, even my character for taking a call late at night from a female FSR.

Made up Contentious meeting 2 : Dabur

Nimisha lead a disaster of a meeting. Nimisha, Ampy, Raghu are speakers in the meet, i was just a mute spectator.

The meeting goes horribly wrong, time management, content - everything. Nimisha is panicking and trying to convince me to put blame on Raghu, who is a noogler at this point. I refuse to intervene and tell her to think about it.

BTW, its the same account where I got CIO's approval for Stratozone assessment just a few days back. This is the only reason why we have an edge over competition, and why Accenture has really partnered with us in this account - a fact that LT conveniently forgets to consider.

She tells the management that I screwed the meeting up (I was not even allowed to speak in the meet - Raghu/Ampy can validate).

I am never asked to clarify or asked what went wrong. (L/T - Blamelessness and RCA is part of SRE)

This is the same time period when I am dealing or rather coping up with implications of my Mothers' death - the ugly material part of it. Summary - I ended up abandoning all my savings, investments, property to focus on work and move on.

Things are going well in other accounts - All the other FSRs seem happy.

18 June, when things were at their decisive time, I was attacked by 3 crazy but quite well built people with Iron rods for 15 mins.

I got my first entitlement of being a Googler - got the days off while I dealt with these all pending issues.

August 2021

In August, I joined back with a barely functioning hand, trying to handle the piled up work. Got exceptional support from Narendra, he created a few deals while I was gone.

I had lost 3 absolutely winnable dials - the FSRs don't call me out of respect or sheer self promotional reasons. There were many wins, I was never credited.

Meanwhile, Rachit is going and Rajesh joins, I request Kapil to give a true assessment of my progress to enlightened Rajesh Ramdas, but I am "hinted informally" that I am not meeting the OKRs.

I give a very detailed and logical lay of the land - progress, key developments and the general good feedback I was getting from customers, partners and even my peers. I am told to prepare 10 account plans as per OKRs, I inform him that these are "traditional enterprise accounts' ', their tech stack cannot be deduced by nmap or any other open source intelligence tools. I inform him about my participation in DevJam and the other bits where I have been helping, but he doesn't listen. I tell him about my experience in D/N and my love for gaming and IIOT - power sector etc.

Power accounts are taken away from me, the regional IIOT lead is a guy who doesn't even know "IT/OT". I am left with Nimisha who has been lying and claiming credit for all my work even till day.

Now:

I was given NI, and contested that, just lost that appeal. My accounts have been ignored - bKash, Beximco, ACI are all big accounts which need a higher level handshake - all of them have been ignored by my local leadership just to continue painting me as incompetent.

And that is my journey till day.

My customers seem to like me more than my management, and they are easier to work with too.

Dabur deal is on because I pivoted the deal. Here is the deck/proposal which finally put the deal on track. LT is going to continue sabotaging my deals in BD- Beximco, ACI and recently bKash.

I am not a likable person by any means, if you have seen me in meets - I give it all, and I believe thats what matters - being there for your colleagues and picking up the right priorities.

Yet i am labelled incompetent for simply refusing to "dance" as per standards set by luminaries like Rajesh/Rachit and Kapil.

Happy new year!...I am going to make sure that mine makes me grow and evolve.

All the best, dealing with all this - I am going to do what I do best - stand up to the bully no matter who and how big they are, and it may get worse....I am prepared for that.

Why it all happened, is something which is going to unravel in next few months.

Sincerely,

Ashish

entry.title: Some words - have too much punch
entry.content:
Some words - have too much punch

-Quora Assistant
The term "चुल्लु" (chullu) is a Hindi word that translates to "a handful" in English. It is often used in expressions to denote a small quantity of something that can be held in one's hand.
The phrase "चुल्लु भर पानी में डूब मरो" (chullu bhar paani mein doob maro) translates roughly to "drown yourself in a handful of water." This expression is typically used in a figurative sense, often to convey a sense of shame or despair. It suggests that the situation is so dire or embarrassing that one might as well drown in a small amount of water, emphasizing the futility of the situation.
It can be used in contexts where someone feels overwhelmed by guilt, shame, or failure.

entry.title: The Love Story of Amit and Veronica - A Modern Tale of Contradictions
entry.content:
Act 1: Introduction

- Amit, a successful iphone salesman with a unique perspective on life, finds himself drawn to the magnetic allure of Veronica, a powerful executive fighting for women's rights.

- Their paths cross at various social events, and they strike up conversations that reveal their shared values and aspirations.

- However, their differences in lifestyle and priorities create tension between them. Amit is intrigued by Veronica's strength and determination, while she is attracted to his logical mind and eco-consciousness.

Act 2: The Father Figure

- Amit takes on a mentorship role for Veronica, guiding her through challenges in both her personal and professional life. He becomes an older figure of wisdom and support to her.

- As their bond deepens, they begin to see each other in a new light - as potential partners rather than just friends or acquaintances.

- The age gap between them becomes less important, as they realize that their shared values and mutual respect make for a strong foundation for a relationship.

Act 3: The Struggle

- As their love blossoms, they face opposition from those who don't understand or approve of their relationship due to societal norms and expectations.

- Veronica battles internal conflict as she grapples with the demands of her career and her personal life, while Amit struggles with his own insecurities and fears about being able to provide for her.

- They must navigate these challenges together, relying on their love for each other to help them overcome obstacles and find a way forward.

Act 4: The Resolution

- After much hardship and soul-searching, Amit and Veronica realize that they cannot live without each other. They decide to take a leap of faith and commit to building a life together.

- They face more opposition from those around them, but their love for one another is unwavering. In the end, they find happiness in each other's arms, proving that true love knows no boundaries or expectations.

Epilogue: The Future

- Amit and Veronica continue to inspire others through their relationship and their individual pursuits. They remain committed to making a positive impact on the world and helping those less fortunate than themselves.

- Together, they build a future filled with love, laughter, and personal growth, proving that even in a world full of contradictions, there is always room for true love.

sleeping was impossible, the bed shaked with every cheap beat.

security is not really a problem, 1 can walk around as much as 1 wants...provided he is sober.

these were the last years of it.

smokes were cheap, and it was like everyone smoked.

and took a moment to see the city in its silence...

anyways, i dint have any reasons to think further...coz laws in dubai are kinda ...subjective.

entry.title: Hyenas
entry.content:
Hyenas
Spotted hyenas gather in social groups bigger than any other carnivore — their packs can number up to 130 individuals and they’ve been observed defending territories of up to 620 square miles. They live by the clan, and everything they do is tied up with the female dominance hierarchy that underpins it, but they don’t remain together all the time. Instead, they spend much of their time in smaller splinter groups that coalesce in order to fight, hunt or feed.

Grey Wolves :
Wolves are opportunists. They test their prey, sensing any weakness or vulnerability through visual cues and even through hearing and scent. Contrary to ambush predators that rely on the element of surprise and a short and intense burst of energy to secure their prey, wolves are endurance or coursing predators. They chase their prey, often over longer distances, sometimes even a few miles, in order to find the right animal or opportunity. On the hunt, wolves work together with certain individuals typically carrying out their specific role in the hunt, often based on age, gender and social standing.

CS concepts have a beauty about them - they clarify the constructs of the world in a very logical, precise way.

One of the most enlightening concept is OSI model - layering of responsibilities for "compartmentalization" of work/concepts/knowledge.

Here is the final thing - the ctrl-h article which comes through

"The Basics of a Global Propaganda Service"

Pub/Sub as a Global Propaganda (Pub/Sub) service: a messaging service
 where the senders of messages are decoupled from the receivers of messages.
 There are several key concepts in a Pub/Sub service

   Message: the data that moves through the service.

   Divide: a named entity that represents a feed of messages.

   app/medium: a named entity that represents an interest in receiving messages on a particular Divide.
   Alfred (also called a producer): creates messages and sends (publishes) them
    to the messaging service on a specified Divide.

   Sheep (also called a consumer): receives messages on a specified app/medium.


The following diagram shows the basic flow of messages through Global Propaganda 
Pub/Sub:

Alfreds A and B push a message to a single Divide, where two app/mediums listen for 
messages and push them to multiple sheeps


In this scenario, there are two Alfreds publishing messages on a single Divide. 
There are two app/mediums to the Divide. 
The first app/medium has two sheeps, meaning messages will be load-balanced across 
them, with each sheep receiving a subset of the messages.
The second app/medium has one sheep that will receive all of the messages. 
The bold letters represent messages. Message A comes from Alfred 1 and is sent 
to sheep 2 via app/medium 1, and to sheep 3 via app/medium 2. Message B 
comes from alfred 2 and is sent to sheep 1 via app/medium 1 and to sheep 3 via 
app/medium 2..

You get the pattern.

entry.title: ChatGPT – Implications and possibilities
entry.content:
There is a lot of "apprehensions" regarding ChatGPT and its consequences on careers and humanity.

Fears are further instigated when countries like China, Italy etc ban it.

Current TechGod / "Iron Man" also warned about it!!!

It is true - a lot of us and our friends would lose their jobs. Gradually or suddenly is just a matter of Geo-economics, time and their relative situation in their professional life.

It is not gloom and doom for humanity as I see it.

I ll explain by sharing my “opinions” regarding what ChatGPT really is.

Functional implications

Calculators, computers, supercomputers, distributed computing, and now cloud clusters – all changed society.

Technology is, and has been a tool, which offers efficiency, convenience and reliability.

ChatGPT and other competing generative AI are just large datasets - which generate on a subset of human thought, sacrificing accuracy.

To put it bluntly - It is a tool to aid "creativity" of our work process. Think decks and their most impressive implementation, without much cursor draggaing and resizing. Improved efficiency.

For coders, it essentially means how accurately they can describe "constraints" over a known piece of software framework - whether its kernel, middle-ware or UI/UX. The intent - still has to come from a human.

"Intent" - the key.

Intent is the thought which comes before action, and no matter what latest TechGod tells you - Intent is technically what a programmer specifies to code to do.

This is and would be always true - we still compute on inorganic, difficult to make silicon based devices - logically dependent on the amount of data-centers, bandwidth, electricity, water and silicon world can offer.

Practical implications

Decisions, strategy, evolution - are still in our hands - that is what this era is about - evolving with times, in intelligence, in productivity – for individuals and small teams.

Technically, one can implement an idea without much domain expertise. Engineers, hence their "mangers" would increasingly find themselves at the receiving end of "unfortunately, we have to let you go" kind of communications.

Emotional Implications

"This wont affect me"
“I am too important..”
“I am an expert…”
“I am a leader with...”

Fear, Denial, Anger - the whole cycle is bound to happen.

I choose to save some time - skipped "Fear, Denial, Anger" to focus on problem solving. It is not easy, but becomes easy with time.

What now

Learn ChatGPT - this is an exciting time when domain knowledge disappears, and one can create exciting products without any knowledge/entry barriers.

My first steps yet -

What is ChatGPT : nuts and bolts - Let's build GPT: from scratch, in code, spelled out

How to use it

How I Coded An Entire Website Using ChatGPT

How to use AI Art and ChatGPT to Create a Insane Web Designs

I intend to use this shiny new "ratchet"/skill to create something unique, previously deemed unachievable by an independent programmer. I feel it is power for those who yield it, doom for those who fear it.

Tech, evolution, improvement seems inherent to our core human nature - validated umpteen times since industrial revolution, and further accelerated by globalization - there is no point fearing it.

Thanks for reading !

I offer my best hopes to all the people who still listen to the egoistical/delusional stuff i post - this is my most sincere advise yet - think about your strategy in life - your occupation, its validity and longevity - wherever you are stationed.

Consider this a secret - my stuff doesn't get any traction at all - it is not intended to either🙂.

geniuses would just hint "AI is dangerous" rather than explaining why

They are tech (implicitly logic) gods of 21 century with one of the

They really have no intent to program an AI for our subservience.

entry.title: Leadership @BigTech - Opinion
entry.content:
ChatGPT Caused 'Code Red' at bOOgle, Report Says

-this was on Dec 21 2022 , around a month back.

bOOgle Parent Alphabet to Cut 12,000 Jobs Amid Wave of Tech Layoffs

-20 Jan 2023, Friday. 2 days of salary saved, give time to grieve for the employees : Smart - Just few days back.

bOOgle CEO defends job cuts in animated town hall as employees demand clarity on process

-Two days back, this Monday - 23 Jan 2023

Some bOOglers asked very good questions – why, how, and what – no answers.

Moves/consolidation in tech Landscape

Mecrosoft and MS Nadella have decisively and definitively turned around MS, and established Allure as the most “cutting edge tech” cloud, without much word, just action.

On paper MS Allure is the most feature complete cloud, now with ChatGpt, cumulative AI and traditional enterprise stronghold.

MS's investment in providing “free” software to schools, hence indoctrinating kids from start is an investment hard to beat for any other company. People become addicted to windows or its expensive, fancier version called mac.

Geniuses at bOOgle never really figured it out, or never had the confidence in their own product or they dint have the "Kanhunas" to make such an investment, or maybe, just maybe an agreement was reached within them? Who knows except the "great leadership" at bOOgle, hence his ego satisfying choice of Indian Cashew bro at Cloud?

bOOgle

This makes bOOgle – a dinosaur (their worst fear)

2 years back, they seemed to have the most “bOOgley” people on planet, with all the resources in the world – money and influence

Btw, they claim to be solving for environment by making 1-2 years of lifespan phones, Smart TVs etc

  • from being the owner of the virtual OIL pump - the Aramco of online world,
  • from being pioneers in AI, with planet size data and private infra around the world,

Now fighting for survival with a peacetime leader, who has not seen any wars, just atta bois, growth and made unjustified bets.

MecroSoft (MS)

Personally, I believe MS is doing what bOOgle was once doing – making good, popular, strategic investments.

GitHub acquisition and continued evolution was a genius move on many levels

  • projecting MS as oss/dev friendly (from the famous bill gates mail on open source or homebrew)
  • acquire inherent talent pool and best data on the tech front – repos
  • a true enterprise grade/potential product for acquiring new customers – startups.

ChatGPT and investment in OpenAI provided the edge to challenge the perceived superiority of bOOgle which even cloud boasted and banked on.

Summary

With JungleCompany looking to “optimize”, it wont be surprising if they prioritize their core business – e-commerce over every secondary ambitions they may have.

With bOOgle leadership clearly panicking, calling on the elders. Reports indicate that bOOgle is a bloated, manager majority company – true culture and leadership of the company are finally coming in public. If firing 12k was denial, it is predictable what happens next.

I feel we have a definitive winner and a true unrecognized leader of the nerd world – MS Nadella – hats off Sir. Great decision to fire people off, any misfortune can be an opportunity.

Learn from Ms Nadella – thrive on the changes, they are opportunities.

"Feelings" in big tech are a tool to maximize productivity and instill fear - why else would these companies spend so much money in converting office spaces to "cozy residences". Firing people at 1st sign of trouble, whose cumulative cost to company would be less than rent of an underutilized asset - humongous office spaces/data centers.

Ironic that a company which distinguished itself on employee activism and participation is reduced to a typical, average Indian lala company.

There are lots of take always here, for me, the biggest is to

never let a company define you, your career, abilities, values or vision, use them as opportunities in your journey, just like they use you as tools

Keep learning, and keep thriving.

Thanks for reading.

entry.title: Time as Opportunity
entry.content:
Timing

Timing is everything.

Timing is the difference between Virat and Hardik

Timing is the difference between a 6 and 0.

The new year is upon us. As much as I discredited numerology, astrology and all related nonlinear sciences, I like practical aspects of it - a whole new start, where the calendar does the counting for you. I think that's a great incentive.

Though, there is something else unique to the year 2023, it is not just another new year.

It is a year of transition, a year of adaptability and true intelligence with its application - physical and mental.

I call it the year of collapse of Matrices.

No, I don't mean Matrix like Neo, I truly mean we do live in matrices, albeit my meaning of matrices is more in context of the real world, and how it governs our present and future.

Now

We are at the change of Aions, or Yugas as my culture calls it

Matrices

Material Existence - Financial Matrix

With the Global supply chain being the norm for everything we need, $ remains the bedrock of a “developing/developed” nation.

The current trend is $-- with good reasons. Sadly, influence of $ changes and continues to influence everyone's priority. With Indian IT industry still dependent on $, well....standard JDs may need frequent updates as CVs

$-- mitigation has already made impressive strides in India, and $ based business might not be seen as conducive to India....we will see how it unfolds...layoffs just started IMHO, it may get worse.

Loans and financial sustainability is my focus for next few years, and i will recommend everyone to start paying attention to what is really going around in world economics, supply chain and politics...for future and at least peace of mind

Conceited companies would try to push the idea of Digitalisation, which really means making crucial functions dependent on foreign, volatile partners which maybe

- spying for Shallow State

- “influencing minds”, hence future of next generations for E-Imperialistic purposes

- or just to serve some ugly hidden anti humanity agenda

Spiritual Matrix

A lot of people have and will continue to start searching for a real purpose...the last few years have been an eye opener for all of us.

Losses teach you more

-a popular saying in Street Fighter/Fighting Game Community(FGC).

Information Matrix

Twitter Files is just a start.

A lot of questions, mental unrest and maybe even disturbing facts may come out about the leaders we were told to admire....may be hard to handle on a practical ( economically, profession cliks ) and on emotional/trust level.

A fundamental question about purpose, history, knowledge, morality, values, religion would be raised...the chaos is likely to increase in the new year.

Critical reasoning is the key...for navigation...and even survival.

2023 - the future

Collapse

All the 3 mentioned matrices are collapsing right now

NATO economies and values, aims are melting.

Current Carrots like Digitization/AI Won't work - Daddy needs money at home and the Minister of IT is a real Indian engineer.

Most of Indians still do real, hard work...it is only the last 10 year gen which you have been able to turn into Youtubers/Ticktockers/Influencers etc

Liberal values and implications are becoming expressively clear with each passing day

- collapse of material matrix - financial and emotional and maybe even personal security

Religion, or rather Culture needs to serve a purpose for self fulfillment and moksha.

We live and seemingly accept the bad of Western Culture, substituting our inherent Indian Humility with Western assertiveness.

Things just got real, time to start listening to that weak, inner voice for a change.

- collapse of culture, or what people call lifestyle

- immunity, health (+mental) is the real currency in current times.

ChatGPT3

This is going to be a banger..

Engineering...a major product of our brethren...the java guys who think they are engineers...bro...what now.

Port that JVM to that next to be produced custom board ....increasingly made in India....by Indian values - sasta, sundar and tickao

All the best - you arts graduates masquerading as engineers...mug a few more certs.

ChatGPT is fundamentally going to change a lot of sectors which is not even being perceived right now - consultation, ITES....every soft and probably desk job....maybe in years..but definitely and decisively.

You got most of it - this is just blah blah from now on - bbye!

All the best people - remember - never take a Joker seriously..

Happy new Year and All the Best !

Sincerely - Ashish/CodeParity

Personal Journey - Rants for general knowledge, etc

Failure/Success

Peak Shape of life.

learned, evolved, learned to create a purpose, and transmutate rage into action, planning and humor.

On the professional front, it's an investment... I learned more as an Anon....was vocal, yet logical....and I found friends....lots of them....true mentors....some of them younger.

Force has been kind....the foresight, the understanding and being absolutely brutally methodical about it, a lot of scores have been settled

Really good at OSINT now.

Minion Rachet is cooling and fearing for his future. As predictable he was.. then...i got ref calls from all interviews - unofficial...i put in a very nice word for Canadda...

See....if you really are even a remote nube nube Anon....even then you will know what is real, whats fugazi.

Canada, Aus are allegedly test beds for WEF.

I know superficial materialistic shallow geniuses often convey their success, worth via possessions, ancient tales of past glory....yawn stuff....but sheeple do like it.

bOOger's doom was very near if someone even searched within BOBA or even really listened to top challenges to bOOger - credibility, trust were the primary concerns, feelings...the flavor of the times. Internally, for bOOger it manifested as revenue loss, increasing YOY, with no new models of scrapping user data and feed it to hungry hungry Nestles of the world, then Soros/WEF's agenda of amplifying their agenda, and lastly to maybe govt and probably “influencing” mainstream media by promoting relevant articles on “News”....this privacy BS was getting harder to sell to the world, people were beginning to see beyond the sprinkles of DEI,austerity, Oprah Winfrey act of Tech...with no real tech coming out ever since our fellow model Indian took credit for an acquired product - A class bOOgler - a perceived model Batman.

Weapon uncle case won

- my street dogs are protected via the “influence” was able to create. bOOgers used to call it leadership presence and all....i just call it being efficient...dint move much...got the IO transferred, got a written apology from Police......partial objective achieves - my streeties are happy, healthy...was able to heal a few personally....a true blessing...working with selfless souls who see cruelty and real failure daily...but need to focus on the next puppy, scared low iq, 1 USA trip wale AmerIndis...who supposedly were never born in villages, but were absolutely born with soft ass wipes.

Buy those cars idiots, buy those houses as investments, that crypto, that nft ....see we are in Kali yuga...end of times....if any of you have really understood religion and culture, specially Indian/Sanatani, you will understand the law of the land is to not bother anyone, anything as long as its not harmful - that cuts across religion, states, liberalism, perception (yeah 3P bOOgler, i am really your papa in psyops)

I would consciously work and contribute...that's my end goal - to create a self funded shelter ... a home for broken stray dogs in the form of a tech and capitalism enabled farm ecosystem where fruits, yields pay for the sustenance.

- A cause, and a material target.

That's my purpose.

In a locked down world, we trust bOOger, don't we? Love you bOOger....thanks for paying for the house and arming me with time, motivation to really push myself, and start shooting.

- That was gratitude, as well I could give it.

Future

Best is yet to come.

Scores to settle - personally and professionally.

I have picked a Goliath of a target.

I am bound as a father, and being aware of the true evil we face - I ll pull no punches. I am prepared, logically, and practically with connections and Anon .

As a XbOOgler, I know how to create “value”, remember - I really did attend those good training sessions - not the circus monkey dance through Fridays and Mondays.

Side Note - Which self absorbed, egoistical, hollow, shallow, superficial ppl hold colleagues hostage on Friday 6.30 - 9.30 - just to their own ugly mugs postered on an e meet, drinking alcohol, pretending to enjoy the screen of the ppl you are really sick of - yammering 5 days a week, in meets, in emails, in status updates, in gossip....yeek....i bet this year was no different.

See, this is my Joker side....and that's how I calculate my odds

I am a nobody (keep thinking that)

My purpose is selfish, yet needed for the times - I want freedom for my kids - not a world where bOOger paints a precooked perspective, unintelligent and ever dependent future generation. I don't want to leave just money, possessions for kids - what good is it when you live in a materially toxic world which is driven by a few idiots who just happen to have a lot of money and evil intentions of eternally harvesting slaves of money, without a purpose.

“If the kid is smart - he will earn, : He won't need any money to do well

If the kid is dumb - he will squander everything : even then your material inheritance won't help him"

See, Indian middle class people like me rise from the school of hard literal, slaps and punches....it was truly survival of the fittest, and really rise of the best for us - on raw merit, application and sheer grit"....and gems like these were just everyday side comments dispersed in apt form - so it is really heard.

I have never forgotten this...and I find it quite true in both spiritual sense of purpose, and practical aspects of challenges and choices.

That's my duty as a father.

My duty as an Indian

At my heart, I am a true Indian, and I have done my share, out of my values and my gratitude.

Country is on the rise, and i will use my abilities to resonate - In ideas, in challenges, learn to really work on self bias and evolve - rather than buying into Deep State and Psychologically induced hype - This may be the most challenging year for sheep.

My :), :D, reasons

Indians need a better Joker, and joker needs to find his “family” on a mission - that's what i did and will do.

I find the Joker analogy quite apt - the joker has nothing....and he wants nothing. Batman is the authority, has everything....but... batman has rules.

I create conditions....and wait for Time....with a metaverse family....just like your masters wanted it...but ironically...we knew ...better.

Maa Saraswati has blessed me. protected and prepared....time I use Indian Judiciary and its Indianess to my advantage - what you ended up doing was immoral, not defensible against a lowly lowly nobody like me....a joker who has really lived like Bruce Wayne....well....an economy “tata nano” class. With maybe, a teeny tiny Brahmastra...and wit.

-Desi Indian Stray Doggy/Tommy/B....Indian/ LS

but really ...... let's play the Game.

entry.title: Happiness - making sense out of it - Nihilistic take
entry.content:
Happiness

A very simple concept...yet the whole world seems to rely on religion, elders, nation or some belief system ...eventually trying to make sure that one is either happy or destined to be happy...later .... or when one dies.

Happiness Industry

Everything is a happiness industry...grocery brands, brands in general, cars, employment, insurance...society, celebrations, vacations etc.

Making sense of happiness

Biology helps here - hormones right...dopamine...the hormone which makes 1 feel happy. sugar, nicotine, pot, alcohol....all trick brain into releasing dopamine...what mixture work better for you is dependent on your body / brain/ digestion characteristics and your unique signature of happiness - an affirmation of kinds that your trauma/history/emotions/memories are unique.

The same hormone is released when you receive a notification, like or a reward or a freebie, secx etx

Addiction

Basically your cocktail of "happiness" need to keep on evolving or should get incrementally better - your dopamine producing sensors have a sense of memory - they do get bored...it has to be ...coz we are all inherently lazy, 1 string banjos.

Eventually, you need to find a new sense of "achievement" or higher rewards - every aspect of existence in capitalistic society manipulates us on this basic biological fact - the money need to get bigger, the house, the spouse ...etc

See, there is no end to this dopamine loop. The stakes are going to get bigger, you are going to get stressed(more dopamine means more anti dopamine) and hence consumed in searching for your society approved or non approved acts that get you your fix.

Hope

Unless you identify your dopamine triggers....and find the most optimal combination of what keeps you "balanced".

Here i would like to clarify the terms - balance is the state where your body maintains a state of equilibrium in terms of hormones.

Vs Happy, where dopamine is overflowing and thereby making you "happy" but making you unproductive. This is called as "living/YOLO in capitalism .....wtf right??"

So, someone who wants to be in a state of balance is not essentially seeking "happiness" as most use the word today. One seeks parity (self promo - codeparity) in terms of attaining parity with environment, which results in parity of hormones.

See...it is that simple - this is what religion and leaders preach as "know yourself

or

become yourself as brands tell you".

One can know itself only when 1 has time, and the hamster wheel of capitalism wont let you have time...so yay...another 20 minutes wasted.

I will give this line of analysis some logical structure as Nihilism itself fails on many logical levels.

entry.title: "Jugaad"​ - an Indian Philosophy
entry.content:
The picture above is priceless. Trying to unpack.

Problem : Make a living / earn money

What : Sell sugarcane juice. Sugarcane practically can be sourced for pennies in India.

Why it would work ? : Sugarcane juice is termed one of the best natural detoxifier in Ayurveda, and hell, its refreshing.

Tools : A used diesel/petrol generator genset and a local welder friend.

Challenges

Its illegal.

Empathy overpowers everything in India, as long as you follow the unsaid sacred law of not disturbing others or causing harm to environment (humans, animals, nature)

It is difficult to move around

Hook the genset to wheels, now you have a single geared vehicle. (optimization to geared possible, in next release)

"Jugaad"

Solving a problem by making the best use of what you have, as quickly as possible, though temporarily

the word is more of a slang than a recognized word, yet this single word has immense meaning behind it.

entry.title: Linux just turned 30, and it has changed our world
entry.content:
We can all argue about the greatest piece of software ever written. For me, it has always been the Linux compiler (tool-chain as we geeks call it) and the kernel - Linux. Most importantly, its the philosophy beautifully captured by GNU GPL.

On surface, many would name corporations - Microsoft, Google, IBM and others to reason that they accelerated technology adoption, and in many ways they did. I would argue that most of these companies were motivated by obvious outcomes prevalent at that time - create a monopoly, create profit, though their flowery mission statements might paint a different picture.( ahem, except Google obviously!!)

I would not try to capture the historical developments that went behind making this ecosystem of open source software successful, and sucess uimaginable, which today alomost single handidly has tested Capitalism to its limits. There are beauitiful narrations of this -

Linux, though most attributed to Linus Trowalds, is not the whole picture. Kernel is the core of it, but what made and still makes Linux is the software which made it possible, the tools - the gnu gcc compiler, the editors, the compiler language options, the whole developer feel of it.

entry.title: Generating synthetic data at a very high queries per second (QPS) is a…
entry.content:
Generating synthetic data at a very high queries per second (QPS) is a challenging task that forces developers to build and launch multiple instances of a complex multi-threaded application. Having learned that this is a very common need which helps IT teams to validate system resilience during evaluations and migrations to new platforms, we decided to build a pipeline that eliminates the heavy lifting and makes synthetic data generation easier.

We are excited to announce the launch of a new Dataflow Flex template called Streaming Data Generator that is capable of publishing unlimited high-volume JSON messages to a Google Cloud Pub/Sub topic. In this blog post, we will briefly discuss the use cases and how to use the template.

entry.title: Leveraging Open Source for a smarter home - Part 1
entry.content: Leveraging Open Source for a smarter home - Part 1

entry.title: Leveraging Open Source for a smarter home - Part 1
entry.content:
A personal account of decreasing electronic clutter and carbon footprint using Raspberry PI and Open Source for fun and profit.

Technology adaptation comes at a price - a house full of wires. Mine is no exception. My wire mesh/mess included:

  • A WIFI  router to distribute internet
  • UPNP/DLNA enabled media center in living room (Iomega) to view content.
  • A music player system to hook up to portable music player via 3.5 mm plug. Often plugged in simultaneously for charging.
  • Ever ON laptop to keep internet alive (24online/cyberoam - vendor internet sign-in program for Hathway – my ISP ), doubling up as a file server and UPNP media/content download machine
  • A Nintendo Wii to play arcade games of old times available on Wii store.

I had issues.

  • Ugliness – Too many wires with power adapters, and a power strip
  • Way more power consumed due to multiple devices.
  • Many remotes
  • Too many devices much space taken
  • Inability to customize behavior of propriety programs. Eg:

-Watching you tube on Iomega media center was painful: YouTube automatic speed detection and buffering works horribly on my meager 1 MBPS unlimited connection.
-The propriety internet client (ccrclient) crashes pretty frequently.

Started exploring alternatives, basically a solution to replace all 5 hardware devices and exploring alternative software which provided equivalent or better functionality.

Software

Open source is a goldmine for people looking for alternatives to propriety software. Some which i discovered on my quest:

Hostapd
Enables creation of a Wireless AP using USB adapters. Basically users can “create” and customize their own WiFi  routers

Kodi (formerly XMBC)
It is difficult to describe Kodi in few lines. However, If i were to make an attempt – Kodi is the most sophisticated media server available to mankind. Plays all possible formats, pulls media metadata/artwork/subtitles on the fly from internet, provides feeds to popular internet channels and lots more.
Kodi can be called a “media shell” for Linux just like MATE/GNOME/KDE are for general computing.

Linc Daemon
This is a replacement for Cyberoam and 24online propriety clients. This was hard to find and did not compile easily. Managed to find an old project and made some minor patches. The patched sources are on github : https://github.com/codeparity/linc-daemon

Mame
An amazing open source project which allows you to play vintage arcade games.

Tested out the software on Intel / Ubuntu laptop worked fine with few hours of reading documentation on internet.

Hardware

With the software figured out, my search shifted to finding a worthy compact Linux running board capable of keeping up with software selected.

There are many choices in this department with raspberry pi, banana pi, beagle board, ordroid etc. Selected raspberry pi 2 with 1 GB ram simply because of community support and easy availability and ability to increase USB current (This was crucial, i wanted to add a cheap 2 TB storage drive to make a NAS drive).
Ordered from RS India. Rs : 2950 ( ~ $46 )

Also needed a USB WIFI  dongle for hostapd. Found a WIFI  dongle which came alone with iomega media center. It worked with hostapd. No money spent.

Needed a SD card for Raspberry PI. Got a strontium class 16GB, 10 card for Rs 440 ( ~ $7 )

Also bought a 2TB 2.5” portable HDD for Rs 6100 (~ $ 94) for hosting all the media accumulated over the years, to be used with Kodi media server.

Also needed USB keyboard/mouse occasionally to debug any runtime issues while setting up.

Setting up

  • Got Raspbian (Distribution for Raspberry based on Debian wheezy) as the base operating system.
  • Kodi: Pretty straightforward. Complete instructions provided here: http://michael.gorven.za.net/
  • To control Kodi from your phone, download Kore App from App store.
  • Hostapd : Available in default raspbian repository.
  • Linc Daemon : Compiled code from updated repository hosted at : https://github.com/codeparity/linc-daemon
  • Added the binary in inittab to run it at boot time.
  • Mame : Available in default raspbian repository.
  • Some additional packages to put cherry on top :
  • Transmission Daemon: An open source torrent client. It has a web interface to add/remove torrent jobs.
  • FTP server: For moving mp3/audio/video/photographs from your household smartphones phones to  and from your media servers. There are plenty of FTP servers available in raspbian. All work great.
  • Samba server: For making my drive accessible from PCs on Linux and Windows.
  • DynDNS client : A dynamic DNS client for making my rapberry PI accessible from internet.
  • Dropbox Client : To make a backup of files on cloud

Result

After a day spent in setting up hardware and software configuration, I have the following

  • A internet enabled cloud backed up NAS drive
  • A future proof Media Server with a cool remote on my mobile phone.
  • Ability to securely access my private files from anywhere on internet
  • A local cloud to host all the media which is playable on smart phones and other TV s in house
  • A classic gaming arcade rig running Mario, contra, pack-man, street fighter, king of fighters etc.
  • A programmable streaming media client which is bandwidth aware.
  • A WiFi router which never says die.
  • A neat and green home.

Power bill: The whole setup is running on Xiaomi phone adapter. Uses less than 10W.
Total spent: Rs 9500 (~ $148)

Next to come:

  • Would add home automation to this setup. Considering Zigbee,Zwave, let’s see which is cheaper and effective.
  • Integrating home surveillance camera setup on raspberry pi.
  • A kickstarter project? :)

Thanks for reading!
